caseStudiesPage.title: Case Studies
caseStudiesPage.subtitle: Measured outcomes from recent product and growth work.

noor-retail.title: Noor Retail
noor-retail.subtitle: Arabic storefront relaunch with 38% lower CPL
noor-retail.challenge: English campaigns performed well but Arabic landing pages converted at half the rate, inflating overall acquisition costs.
noor-retail.approach: We rebuilt Arabic product pages with RTL-first design, rewrote ad copy with native reviewers, and restructured Meta campaigns by language.
noor-retail.summary: A full Arabic funnel rebuild that finally matched English campaign performance.

fleetpulse.title: FleetPulse
fleetpulse.subtitle: Bilingual Next.js dashboard in six weeks
fleetpulse.challenge: FleetPulse needed a customer dashboard supporting Arabic RTL and English LTR without maintaining two separate codebases.
fleetpulse.approach: We shipped a Next.js app with locale routing, shared component library, and accessible UI patterns tested in both directions.
fleetpulse.summary: One codebase, two languages, enterprise-grade performance.

gulfpay.title: PayFlow
gulfpay.subtitle: Product marketing for a global fintech launch
gulfpay.challenge: Launching a payments product required trust-heavy messaging across multiple locales without losing brand premium.
gulfpay.approach: We paired regulatory-aware copywriters with a bright marketing site and phased ad rollout across Meta and Google.
gulfpay.summary: A fintech launch that felt local everywhere and cohesive everywhere else.

faqPage.title: FAQ
faqPage.subtitle: Answers to common questions about working with Zyvron Tech.

items.q: Do you work with startups and enterprises globally?
items.a: Yes. We partner with growing startups and enterprise teams worldwide — with flexible collaboration across time zones and languages.

items.q: Can you support both marketing and engineering?
items.a: Yes. Many clients engage us for integrated delivery — from acquisition strategy through platform engineering — ensuring alignment across disciplines.

items.q: How do you approach multilingual products?
items.a: We architect for every target locale from the outset — layout, routing, content, and QA — with native-language review at each stage.
Campaign launches are typically live within 2–4 weeks. Platform and application projects range from 6–12 weeks depending on scope. We provide a detailed timeline in every proposal.
Yes. We support long-term retainers and embedded squad models for organizations requiring continuous engineering and growth capacity.
